text:
Substations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the major maintenance procedure P2,
which must be performed every ten years as indicated by Y10 in the 
title block.
The first 
draft initiated by eng. M. Wasfy Abdel Fatah El Shafiee at Tahreer Badr 220kv substation, 
Alexandria and West Delta zone.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued,
The qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution 
marks surrounding the work area,
Wear your safety helmet, shoes .... etc
Tools and Equipment
Safety helmet, shoes .... etc
SF6 gas detector
Work to be Carried Out
General checks
Check that breaker assembly and HT-clamps are secure
Check that bolts and nuts are tight.
Check painting.
Check air pressure tank for any water, corrosion and polution.
Function of the non-return valves.
Control block
Check control block and grease in accordance with GMA 2041 072 instruction.
Check valve cartridge and if necessary replace gaskets.
Charging device
Replace all gaskets
Auxiliary switch
Check and clean.
Terminal check.
Check of mechanical interlocking
With test lamp in ON and OFF position.
Pole position indicator
Replace all gaskets,
Function test and replace all gaskets on auxiliary valves.
Check all terminals of the control block.
Main Valve
Check all valves and replace all gaskets.
Primary control valve
Replace all gaskets and grease in accordance with GMA 2041 072 instruction.
Checking for ease movement of the control shaft.
Arcing -/disconnecting chamber
Replace all valve disc and gaskets on all chambers
Check fixed contacts and nozzles on all chambers
Impulse chamber and valve
Check all impulse chambers and valves, replace all gaskets
Resistor
Check resistor and resistor contact for external damage
Replace all gaskets and exchange the silica gel
Check with soapy water all servo valve for tightness
Remove all servo-valves, replace gaskets and re-grease
Check sivering on all capacitors,re-silver if necessary
Check all insulators and re-paint
Clean sloping filter, if necessary replace
Check function of non-return valve
Check all terminals
Function test of all relays
